facts.fact: 读 Hadot《The Present Alone Is Our Happiness》答 Arnold Davidson 之问时感到失望；15 年后看到自己对老人苛刻——他表露 humility 与 chagrin 之混合、自知 caught in performative contradiction——但作者也 was on to something；Davidson 问：discourse 与 practices 在你自己哲学观中的角色？问题可读四 keys：①要 theoretical discourse（关于 discourse/practices 区分）②要 spiritual instruction（inform 兼 transform 读者）③要 bona fide philosophical dialogue（spiritual exercise 的 perfect example）④most pointedly——挑战 Hadot 此刻当场 manifest the real philosopher；作者选读 4：两证据——①John XXIII 轶事：席间上菜失当而 furious；Hadot like Orwell：in these small details that personalities are revealed；in my eyes this man is not a saint；②Hadot 两次 pivot 皆以 adverb Personally 标记——key to reply=inner disposition

Hadot 之绕行两度、自知：第一 detour——borrow distinction from Stoics、real philosopher is not one who speaks but one who acts；Matthew 7:16 by his fruits——real philosopher 须由其生活理解；Orwell：At 50, everyone has the face he deserves；故 Hadot 应被评 as lover of the wise life 非 scholar/historian；discourse 或指示 philosophical life 或 instructive——两者已被排除；discourse soon running out——echoes Tao Te Ching：those who know do not speak / those who speak do not know；第二 detour：You asked me…（自知未答 crux）——contemporaries consider philosophy a discourse, more exactly a discourse on discourse——Personally, I have a different conception——欲自别须 break from theorizing——却 once again take a detour by way of antiquity——need he？作者数 detours：三 hinge（起、中、末）皆标 Personally

denouement=confessional 的 anticlimax：Personally…attempt to lead a philosophical life——conscious, coherent, and rational——results not always of a very high level；hospitals 期间未维持 desired serenity of mind；inner attitudes：concentration on the present instant、wonder in the presence of the world、looking at things from above——to take flight every day（Georges Friedmann）——becoming conscious of the mystery of existence；愈老愈 prefer experience to discourse（default of age）；所 manifest：circumlocution、largely exegete/historian、practiced not constantly/rigorously、惧 aging/illness/death、perception 未 radically irreversibly changed（不 shimmer in splendor）——performative contradictions、asides/detours 显其自知；Davidson 之答 tragic：priority of practice… discourse 被撕离 practical context 则意义不可理解——technically correct 但 blind——整场 exchange 是 comedy；详论此段之因：显示 philosophy as a way of life 之缺、且超越此观则达 religion as a way of life

Hadot 式 way of life 之五缺：①institutionalization 使 privilege discourse over life——research monograph、digital age content 生产——career 之需；Taoist sage（walk leaving no trace、少言）不 fit institutional picture——Hadot in exchange 乃 live 案例；②classical 中 logic/metaphysics 服务 ethics——modern 中 ethics 之优先变 thinning of rigors——philosophy as a way of life 入 modern 便近 self-help 或 modern stoicism——psychological man 以 exercises 求 well-being（Rieff）；对照 classical Advaita Vedanta：metaphysics at center、practices=confirmations of metaphysical teaching——soteriology inextricably metaphysical——practices 离不开 intellectual grasp of reality；③no genuine path——only a la carte spiritual exercises：which exercises 未知、无 guides、无 progressive order——practices fall by the wayside 或 lose direction；④no epistemic verification——无 recognized Sage 能 discern——对照 Zen：roshi interview 判 satori（clear seeing of self-nature）；⑤ever on the way（asymptotic）之 view 虽谦却留不下 finality 之可能——Is nobody ever wise？——modern/postmodern 之 open-endedness 与 critique of teleology 已过头——修正 dogmatism 之用已尽、如今只留 stranded 与 de-motivated；实践上 devolves into self-help 或 retreat to theoretical discourse；作者离场之由：modern 无 academy/lyceum/stoa 以 wise life 为最高优先——Hadot 观念或 slide into antiquarianism、或须寻 self-transformation 前景化的其他传统——须 embrace genuine ongoing spiritual practices from living tradition；姐姐意外死后初转向 Zen Buddhism
facts.anchor: Hadot’s philosophy as a way of life is striking

facts.fact: 2013 年 12 月大姐 Jen 送医——从未病过、重到须叫救护车；查出 cancer of indeterminate origin——everywhere and nowhere；1 月初与她谈她与丈夫新居后院刚种的 fruit trees——She spoke of seeing them fruit；Twelve weeks later, she was dead；她死后一颗种子种进我心里、metaphysical questions push up through the soil——此后 search for God——for the Reality behind the name——Is this all there is? Is this it?——不知何意却不能放弃；三层含义：①identity——body perished 则 she perished 乎？mind 依 body 乎？有逾 mind-body composite 者？②finitude——limited being？earthly life 尽则 all terminated？what is time？③ultimate reality——world-appearance 于闭眼心灭时 dissolve——则 world-appearance really real？若非 what is？——felt some finality couldn't comprehend

开于此 metaphysical question 前，我 quietly 被 Taylor 的 immanent frame 所 captivate；其《A Secular Age》：lives understood as taking place within a self-sufficient immanent order——无 transcendent 亦能运作、self-perpetuating logic；secular monks 之日：mundanity 与 diurnality 弥漫——daily affairs/tasks/projects 由 habits 塑形——no world but this one, no day but today, no self but the perishable mind-body composite——mundanity/diurnality/finitude 合成 profane ordinariness——unimaginable anything beyond typical and expected——I am finite, time is scarce, this world is all there is；作者虽求 wisdom 而非 self-optimization/success，与 secular monks 一样未质问 good life 追求的 metaphysical basis——直到 Jen 之死 2014

Zen 看似不谈 metaphysical debates——但（作者之见）无 prior intellectual grasp of Buddha nature 则无 genuine zazen；koan cases take up mind/ego/no-mind no-self——time and again 显示 cutting through mere intellection——experiential understanding 须 deep in one’s bones（Zen teacher 语）；上述诸缺（metaphysics first/genuine path/epistemic verification/telos 之清晰表达）皆可由 Zen 等 rigorous Eastern traditions 解决；philosophy as a way of life 对作者只是 stepping stone——通往 thick religious conception of a way of life；深度 Socratic 者继续 inquiry 到底——别无他途；Zen 教人 go beyond all conceptions、mind notions 之最后 vestige——includes going beyond philosophy

2019 年 1 月 sesshin（Rinzai 教师 Jeff Shore）——What brings you here?——答 Enlightenment——the longing to know who I am——Shore knowingly 看我；早前 dokusan 问 natural koan（rises up out of your experience）——答 Is this all there is? Is this it?；Shore nod：Continue zazen with extended outbreath while silently seeking to get to the bottom of your koan；我回到禅堂——hair on fire——I am a living inquiry
